job: a healthy purified monocyte, read against the atlas's monocytes and tared against other healthy monocytes of the same laboratory, reads Normal; a 1 % loss of its pattern stands out
data: GSE267660, the 31 healthy donors' CD14 monocytes in seal_samples.csv (the multiple sclerosis arrays and the dendritic cells not opened)

B1.rule: at least 90 % of the listed arrays receive a tared reading

B2.rule: at least 90 % of the tared healthy readings are Normal (0.95 to 1.05)

B3.rule: the planted 1 % loss moves the tared reading, on average, by at least 2 healthy spreads (spread: SD of the healthy A_rel)

reported_not_scored: the same tare taken only from other healthy arrays on the same slide, where a slide holds at least 3 others

rehearsal.result: 24 of 24 tared; 100 % Normal; planted 1 % at 3.41 spreads; same-slide tare (8 arrays) 100 % Normal, 4.6 spreads
